report_topic: Performance Audit of Systems and Controls in Assessment and Collection of Revenue from Minor Minerals
observations_summary: The audit found significant revenue losses due to irregularities in lease grants, non-operationalization of sources, non-realization of mineral dues, application of pre-revised rates, quarrying without proper deeds/clearances, illegal extraction beyond limits/depth, and ineffective monitoring. Total revenue leakage/loss identified was substantial, including ₹864.45 crore due to non-deduction of charges from public project contractors.
